note: Pass 2026-11-04. Register join (Wisconsin DNR champions) plus the Arboretum, UW and City of Madison pages. Five verified in data/research/madison-verified.json.

leads.name: Silver Maple, Edgewood campus
leads.reason: Register champion (202.9 in, 110 ft), alive per iNaturalist 2024-03-24, but the owner is a private campus school; no source shows the grounds are open to walkers. Needs an access source.

leads.name: Bur Oak, Warner Park
leads.reason: City of Madison 2012 Heritage Tree Award, Landmark category, public park at N Sherman Ave; no coordinate, girth or which trunk found. Next pass: the city's heritage page or the Remarkable Trees of Dane County map.

leads.name: Cottonwood grove, Yahara Place Park
leads.reason: City of Madison 2012 Heritage Tree Award, Collection category, Lake Monona shoreline; a grove, not one collectible point unless one trunk is named.

leads.name: Remarkable Trees of Dane County map
leads.reason: A public crowd-sourced map of 100+ trees (WPR article names a very large sugar maple and red oak near the state hospital, an elm at Badger Prairie County Park, a cottonwood by an elementary school); not read in this pass because the map itself is not machine-readable from here. Best next angle for Madison.

blocked.name: Red Oak on the Eagle Effigy Mound, Mendota Mental Health Institute
blocked.reason: Working state hospital; a mound-marker source says permission is needed to visit the grounds (hard rule 10). Register: looked dying 2013, alive 2022 (iNaturalist 2024). Same for the large sugar maple there named by WPR.

blocked.name: Dawn Redwood, Dorsett Drive (register 1718)
blocked.reason: Backyard of a private home; not visible as a public tree.

blocked.name: Lapham bur oak, Edgewood Drive
blocked.reason: DNR 'Every Root an Anchor' chapter says the old bur oak stood until the early 1990s (gone).
